description: Cross-jurisdiction view of one legal concept: every provision tagged with the given EuroVoc concept, with tagging method and confidence. E.g. 'eurovoc:4585' (VAT), 'eurovoc:4392' (VAT rate). The language-neutral way to line up EU and national law on the same subject.
name: provisions_by_concept

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: Provisions tagged with a concept
